selection_event:
    eventName: 'SendCommand'
    eventSource: 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
selection_status_success:
    errorCode: 'Success'

condition: selection_event and 1 of selection_status_*
versions.spl: eventName="SendCommand" eventSource="ssm.amazonaws.com" errorCode="Success" OR NOT errorCode=*
